question: Where and in what form should Ketu be installed in this bodily placement?
premises: The placement is in the region of the anus on two lakṣas.
Ketu is the deity to be installed.
inference: O beautiful-faced one, smoke-colored Ketu should be installed in the anus region on the two lakṣas.
uncertainties: The exact technical meaning of lakṣābhyāṃ in this nyāsa context is unclear.
plain_english: O beautiful-faced one, place smoke-colored Ketu in the region of the anus on the two lakṣas.
